messages:
Jordan (CSM): Hey team — scheduling the Savannah Health onboarding kickoff. Proposed time: Mon 10am PT. Need owners for integration, data mapping, security sign-off, and clear 30/60/90 success criteria. Who can own what?

Priya (Eng): I can own integration + sandbox readiness. ETA: Wed EOD for sandbox and test creds.

Liam (Solutions): I'll handle data mapping and workflow config. Need a sample schema and example rows from the customer. @Sam (Savannah) can you send that today?

Sam (Savannah): Yep, I'll upload a sample CSV to the shared drive by EOD and ping here.

Emilia (Product): For success metrics I suggest: p95 inference latency < 1s on dev tier, 90%+ extraction match rate on our eval set, and 3 core workflows live and exercised by end of 60 days. Also need a short eval prompt set from the customer.

Jordan (CSM): Good framing. Primary risks I see: PII routing requirements (customer wants VPC + KMS), and the initial model variant might need tuning which could delay 'live' date. @Miguel (CS) can you confirm whether Private deployment + KMS is acceptable and what the timeline looks like?

Miguel (CS): Confirmed — legal ok with VPC but KMS integration needs our security checklist completed. I'll deliver the checklist and required docs by Thu. Possible blocker: customer-side firewall rules may need networking lead.

enablement-bot: Reminder: onboarding playbook created -> /playbooks/savannah-onboard. Tasks assigned: Jordan (owner), Priya (integration), Liam (data), Miguel (security). Due dates set in playbook.

Priya (Eng): Sandbox will be up Wed. I'll post endpoint + creds here and I propose a quick dry-run of the kick-off meeting on Fri 9am PT to walk through the agenda and handoffs.

Sam (Savannah): Fri 9am PT works for us.

Jordan (CSM): Agenda I'm planning (short):
```
- 10m intros & stakeholders
- 15m integration plan (Priya)
- 15m data mapping (Liam + customer)
- 10m security & KMS requirements (Miguel)
- 10m success criteria & next steps (Jordan / Emilia)
```

Jordan (CSM): Action items after this thread: Priya -> sandbox + creds; Liam -> request sample schema + prework questions to Sam; Miguel -> security checklist (Thu); Emilia -> share eval prompts; Jordan -> send meeting invite + success criteria doc. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the one-pager. :thumbsup:
